title: Origin story: Obsidian Jack
description: Obsidian Jack was a sailor shipwrecked on the glass isle, where volcanic glass forms cliffs sharp as knives. He learned to sail the glass reefs, to read the black mirrors, and to cut rope, sail, and fate with obsidian blades. He sails still, in a ship with a glass hull, trading in reflections.

title: Ability profile: Obsidian Jack
description: Ranked abilities: Glass-reef navigation — rank 100/100; Mirror-reading — rank 97/100; Knife work — rank 96/100; Seamanship — rank 95/100; Courage — rank 94/100.

title: Power ranking: Obsidian Jack
description: Powers: Obsidian cuts anything, even fate's threads; The black mirror shows truth; His glass ship cannot sink — it is already broken and whole.

title: Stamina feats: Obsidian Jack
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Sailed the reefs for a decade; Faced the mirror's truths unflinching.

title: Crossover notes: Obsidian Jack
description: Obsidian Jack crosses naturally with: volcanic glass, sharp edges, the black mirror.

title: Design notes: Obsidian Jack
description: Sharpness as virtue; the sailor of the black mirror.

description: This record documents the boundless generator for Obsidian Jack's database.
